arms.cross_encoder: intfloat/multilingual-e5-small with a one-logit head, sentence pair '<name> | <LGA>' each side, BCE, 1 epoch, lr 3e-5, batch 32, max_length 96, warmup 0.1, seeds 0-2, Platt-calibrated on the development slice
arms.gate_alone: the engine as is: holds all 180
arms.logistic_baseline: logistic regression on [TF-IDF char-3 cosine, E0c crosswalk encoder seed0 cosine] of the two names, fit on the training examples, Platt-free (its output is a probability), thresholds by the same rule

labels.note: labels file re-saved 2026-11-21 with three corrections; digest is of the file used by the E0b transfer test, unchanged since

question: Can a cross-encoder trained on the GRID3/HFR crosswalk of other states decide part of the Nigerian review band automatically, within an error bound?

rule.decision: auto-match if calibrated P >= hi, auto-reject if P <= lo, else held. hi = smallest threshold whose false-positive rate on the development slice is <= 1%; lo = largest threshold whose false-negative rate there is <= 1%
rule.error_bound: errors among auto-decided <= 3% and Wilson 95% upper bound <= 10%
rule.latency: CPU p95 per pair at 4 threads <= 50 ms
rule.pass: every one of the 3 seeds meets fewer_held and error_bound
rule.population: the 180 review-band pairs of data/review_packs/nigeria_facilities_2026-08-19 marked same_entity or different (86 / 94); used once, never for training, calibration or thresholds
secondary: coverage minus the logistic baseline's coverage (same threshold procedure), paired bootstrap: 'worth its cost' if the lower bound > 0
pair AUC against TF-IDF cosine and the E0c encoder cosine, paired bootstrap
the LLM-judge arm and the cost comparison are deferred: they would send pairs to an outside service

training.negatives: per anchor, up to 3 HFR facilities in the same state and LGA from the TF-IDF top 10 of the GRID3 name, excluding the linked record and any whose folded name equals the GRID3 or linked HFR name
training.positives: GRID3 globalid = HFR global_id pairs; all whose names differ after folding, plus a salted-hash 25% of those whose names are identical
training.split: salted hash of GRID3 globalid: 90% training, 10% development (calibration and thresholds)
training.states: the 34 GRID3 states other than Edo, Kano and Ondo
